Fort Indiantown Gap

  • Official BRAC record for Fort Indiantown Gap (BRAC 1995).

    File type: PDF Source: BRAC Round 1995

    Commission Recommendation Conveyance Report

BRAC Summary: Close Fort Indiantown Gap, except minimum essential ranges, facilities, and training areas as a Reserve Component training enclave to permit the conduct of individual and annual training.

Property Description: Fort Indiantown Gap was located in Lebanon and Dauphin Counties, PA adjacent to I-81, 23 miles northeast of Harrisburg and surrounds Memorial Lake State Park. At the time of closure, the post comprised approximately 18,000 acres. The installation currently serves as a National Guard Training Center.
